title: The Around you map tile shows a real map under its pins instead of an empty dot grid

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20 in the project chat: some of the maps are still messed up (screenshot of the feed right rail, '140 events on the map' over a blank grid)

detail: FILED 2026-10-20. THE CONSEQUENCE: the Around you tile in the right rail and on /events was drawn as an SVG of faint dots over a CSS grid by design (SCAN-975), so it looked like a map that failed to load. THE FIX: the tile mounts a still, non-interactive MapLibre basemap under the pins, drawn through the map seam, so it is Google Maps when the browsable key is set (owner 2026-10-20: it must be Google) and MapLibre when not. A first version pinned it to OpenFreeMap (#3726); the owner asked for Google, so the pin is removed. The SVG stays as the paint while tiles arrive. The lightbox map is unchanged. NOT VERIFIED: the Google browser key, referrer list and billing in production could not be read from this session; docs/MAPS.md section 6 triage applies if the lightbox map is blank.

verify.note: Fails on main (no basemap in the tile), passes with this change.
